吴棠: Wu Tang, Director-General of Grain Transport, then acting Governor of Jiangsu
杨载福/杨岳斌: Yang Zaifu / Yang Yuebin, original and changed name of the same commander
郭筠仙/郭嵩焘: Guo Yunxian / Guo Songtao, same official
曾涤生/曾国藩: Zeng Disheng / Zeng Guofan, same official
马谷山/马新贻: Ma Gushan / Ma Xinyi, same official
禄魁: Lukui, brigade commander killed at Zhangzhou
徐晓峰: Xu Xiaofeng, circuit intendant; distinct from Dexin, courtesy Xiaofeng
量出为入: determine income by expenditure, deliberate inversion in the source
大锯活人: sawing a living man in two, a conjuring metaphor for Zuo’s political pressure
